title: Transition at a Read Boundary
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-alphabet multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $a_0$ be a source-alphabet symbol, let $q$ be a state, let $s$ assign each tape an optional symbol and a Boolean flag, and let $v$ be an optional symbol of the enlarged sweep alphabet. When the simulator is in its read phase and its work head scans the boundary marker, its transition is the stationary phase-change action to the right-growth phase if some tape whose flag in $s$ is true moves right under the source transition computed from the retracted input symbol and the symbols in $s$; otherwise, its transition is the simulator's transition from the right-growth phase with counter $k$ on that same boundary marker.
hypotheses_covered: decidable equality on the source alphabet
